edits.prompt_en: This is a cropped piece of a larger cartoon illustration. Make only the changes listed below and keep everything else exactly as it is: the same people, faces, hair, clothes, poses, background, colors, thick cartoon outlines and framing. 1) The green frog now wears small round black sunglasses. Keep his happy open-mouthed eating face. 2) The bowl of porridge in the frog's hand now sits on a thick closed book: the frog holds the book flat in that same hand like a tray, and the same bowl rests on top of the book. Keep his other hand with the wooden spoon at his mouth. 3) On the floor right under the two hands that are picking up candies and herbs, put an old, worn open book lying flat, with no ribbon and no seal. The fingertips of the lower hand touch its pages, and a few picked herbs and candies lie on the open pages. Keep the two hands exactly as they are, with no arms or bodies attached. Keep the old cracked jar with cobwebs, the low table with the second porridge bowl, the two glass jars at the bottom left and the candy-covered floor exactly as they are. Do not add any other objects, people or animals. No text, no letters, no numbers anywhere. Output the same aspect ratio as this picture.

edits.prompt_en: This is a cropped piece of a larger cartoon illustration. Make only the changes listed below and keep everything else exactly as it is: the same people, faces, hair, clothes, poses, background, colors, thick cartoon outlines and framing. 1) Replace the treasure chest with a thick closed book of about the same size, in the same place, locked shut with a metal clasp and a small padlock; a few white notes still stick out between its pages. 2) The man's hand that holds the black cloth now presses down on the top of the locked book, holding the black cloth over it. Keep his other hand with one finger on his lips saying "shh", and keep his face. 3) Remove every crown from his clothes and hat: the robe now has a pattern of small golden cloud swirls in the same colors, and his black hat is plain with no ornament. 4) Put one large green-brown monitor lizard lying on the wooden floor of the platform on the right side of the book, near his knee. Keep the wooden railing, the trees and sky, the turkey, the sun flag and the edge of the ice block exactly as they are. Do not add any other objects, people or animals. No text, no letters, no numbers anywhere. Output the same aspect ratio as this picture.
